coordinated_activities.activity: Wake up, shower and morning wash
Make and eat breakfast using the kettle and toaster
Get dressed, pack study materials and check the day's class timetable on the computer
Commute to the Monash University campus
Attend Master of Education lectures and seminars on campus
Study in the campus library and review lecture notes on the laptop
Attend afternoon tutorials and work on education coursework assignments
Prepare and eat dinner using the microwave and oven, avoiding the induction cooker during the evening grid peak
Study course readings and complete assignment work on the computer under the desk lamp
Brush teeth and complete nightly wash routine
